title: Songs for the Deaf
producer: Josh Homme, Eric Valentine and Adam Kasper
studio_context: October 2001 to June 2002 at The Site, Conway and Barefoot. The drums in a small, dead booth, 'tight, focused, punchy and kind of claustrophobic'; each song played twice, on cymbal pads and then on real cymbals over a dummy snare and padded toms, and the two blended.

drum_performances.name: Dave Grohl
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His return to the drums as a band member: No One Knows and the record's 'pummeling fills'; Oliveri thought him 'a better drummer' than anything else he did.

drum_performances.name: Gene Trautmann
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Drums on tracks 1 and 8; Grohl replaced him.

drums.description: A rock shuffle in quarters, triplet fills on snare and toms and the kick in quarter-note triplets, the drumming that powered Songs for the Deaf.
